note:
R62 — gen7 arena / ice assets (Teams 2.5): the `exhibitionarena` rows joined to the shipped venue files
`rendering/stadium/stadium_<id>_container_<n>`, `rendering/icesurface/centerlogo_<id>_<map>`, `rendering/jumbotron/texlib_<id>`,
`rendering/banner/banner_<id>[_<k>_<map>]` and `rendering/crowd/chair_<id>_<n>`
on NHL 09–Legacy (X360 + PS3, loose trees or EB archive member listings). Read-only; nothing decoded, no writer.

Per title: the arena rows and the id-like columns; the file families found with their name grammars and the id sets they cover; the join
rate of each candidate key (`index`, `artid`-like columns, `icelogo`, `jumbotron`, …) against each family's id set, both residual
directions (arena rows without files; shipped venue ids without a row), and the per-family part vocabulary (`container`, `bowl`, …) so a
listing page can name the components of one arena. Names and grammars are observations; no runtime consumption is claimed.
Usage: python r62_gen7_arena_asset_join.py <out.json>
